description: Source file defining the SugarFieldEmailBody class, which extends SugarFieldBase to provide methods for rendering email body fields in different views, including detail, edit, and search. It includes methods for sanitizing and processing vardef values for display.

classes.name: SugarFieldEmailBody
classes.description: Represents a custom field for email body content, providing methods for rendering HTML-safe email content in different views.

methods.name: getDetailViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares and returns the HTML content for displaying the email body in the detail view, sanitizing HTML before rendering.

methods.name: getEditViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares and returns the HTML content for editing the email body, sanitizing HTML before rendering.

methods.name: getSearchViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares and returns the HTML content for search view, sanitizing HTML before rendering.

methods.name: getVardefValue
methods.description: Retrieves and encodes the vardef value for display, falling back to default values if necessary, and logging warnings if no value is set.
